argmax: float64 numpy.argmax, lowest class index on exact ties
candidates: sorted unique endpoints 0 and (bounded)3, nonnegative applicable thresholds, midpoint of every consecutive endpoint/threshold; unrestricted adds largest nonnegative endpoint + max(1,abs(endpoint))
floating_point: IEEE float64 thresholds, direct subtraction for predictions; candidate decimal and hex retained
heuristic: absolute accuracy difference <=1 percentage point on EACH primary domain, and scalar true8 errors <= repair true8 errors on EACH primary domain
heuristic_scope: exploratory retrospective decision rule, not statistical equivalence
selection: minimum selected classification errors, then smallest numerical tau
selection_population: each cohort own frozen 100 selected fog examples only
